acceptance_criteria.requirement: The dashboard is at most 1320px wide with at least 16px side margins, 22px top spacing, 12-14px major gaps, and a 72px native-footer safe area.
At 940px and wider the calendar and a right rail remain side by side with a two-by-two metric grid and Bible card beneath it.
From 440px through 939px the calendar precedes a two-by-two metric grid and a full-width Bible card.
At 439px and below the metric cards use one column, content remains vertically scrollable, and cards do not clip.
Below 320px only the Year heatmap may scroll horizontally; the document and Month view must not overflow.
Wide Year height is content-driven at approximately 285-310px and changes by no more than 2px across Bible disabled, short, and long states.
Five-row Month views are naturally shorter than six-row views while cell heights remain about 42-44px wide, 38-42px intermediate, and 34-38px narrow.
Year remains one continuous 53-column presentation with aligned month labels, January and December present, and no transform or zoom scaling.
Completed reviews own cell fill, future cells stay neutral, and due demand uses only the three-level bottom-strip treatment.
Outside-month, future, completion, due, event, today, selected, hover, and focus states follow one deterministic visual and keyboard layering order.
Events use compact gold markers, multiple events use a separate count badge, and markers never overlap dates.
The legend uses Completed reviews with Low and High endpoints, three matching Reviews due samples, and one Event marker.
One delegated 190-220px tooltip flips and shifts within the calendar and viewport, avoids the source cell where possible, and works in Month and Year.
Month and Year form one segmented control; previous, Today, and next form a second cohesive group with a separate settings control.
The integrated footer preserves selected date plus On this date or Next event semantics and uses exactly two compact rows below 700px without collisions.
The event pencil stays adjacent to event information and Reviewed cards or Due cards remains a tonal, non-dominant action.
Today progress is one 12-14px completion bar containing N% complete, never a segmented workload visualization.
No cards scheduled, All clear, 100% complete, and unavailable are distinct states; no unavailable state invents a percentage.
Today’s Progress contains New remaining, Learning remaining, Reviews remaining, and Total remaining.
Today’s Session contains Cards studied, New cards studied, Cards buried, Time spent, Pace, and ETA.
Cards buried remains the scheduler-authoritative current total, has no historical analytics, and visibility.buried is removed.
Last 7 Days contains Cards studied, New cards studied, Retention, and Again rate.
All Time contains Avg cards/day, Current streak, Longest streak, Retention, and Cards studied.
Large values remain stable and time or ETA switches to a compact readable presentation before typography is reduced.
Initial Python rendering and live JavaScript updates consume the same progress, session, time, and footer presentation contract.
A new profile uses deliberate empty-history treatment with No cards scheduled and N/A rates rather than looking partially broken.
Historical all-clear and completed-positive-workload states remain visually and semantically distinct, including ETA Done only for completed positive work.
Bible height is content-driven, long text is not truncated below 14px, custom font affects verse text only, and disabled state leaves no gap.
All palettes derive from centralized thematic and semantic tokens while semantic study colors retain consistent meaning.
Only Sapphire Glass uses component-level 94-100 opacity and real 0-16px backdrop blur.
Graphite and Emerald surfaces remain opaque in both color modes.
High Contrast uses opaque crisp surfaces with no decorative transparency or shadows.
The add-on never creates, recolors, masks, blurs, or scrims the host wallpaper, native deck list, toolbar, footer, or surrounding Anki canvas.
Schema 8 clamps schema-7 opacity and blur, defaults to 96 and 12, removes visibility.buried, preserves unrelated settings, and disables glass controls outside Sapphire.
A valid stored Month or Year value loads before first render, changes only on explicit user selection, and is reused for loading, refresh, retry, theme, settings save, and restart.
Initial and delayed loading reserve the selected Month or Year geometry; delayed loading says Still loading your study data... without changing dimensions.
Initial failure says Dashboard could not load with the required supporting copy and Retry plus Open diagnostics actions, without a fake zero snapshot.
Refresh or retry with prior data keeps that dashboard visible, shows Refreshing..., and exposes failure without discarding the last successful data.
The 1.8.2 archive is built twice identically and passes allowlist, safe-path, ZIP integrity, production import, and byte-for-byte source parity gates.

The exact archive runs in a fresh sync-disabled Anki 26.8.1 profile, produces 47 initial frames plus RUNTIME-RESTART-PERSISTENCE, one overview and 13 detail sheets, and restart persistence has no waiver.

The supplied screenshot and retained 1.8.0/1.8.1 evidence remain unchanged calibration history; 125/150%, spoken screen reader, Windows/Linux, forced colors, and OS scaling stay explicitly deferred and unclaimed.
